note: Mechanisms are kept SEPARATE from Evidence Sets (Fresco). An Evidence Set holds only candidate_mechanisms: [MC-...] links; this registry aggregates, per mechanism, its supporting evidence sets, the relevant decisions, and the engineering rules derived from it. A mechanism is promoted only when a criterion recurs across real decisions (decision_library) — born from data, not impression.

watched_patterns.statement: Recoverability after remix may distinguish reversible separation from irreversible failure.
watched_patterns.based_on: ≈4 evidence sets · one product family · same experimental environment
watched_patterns.note: NOT a Mechanism Candidate yet — too few evidence sets, single environment. Watch; promote only if the criterion recurs across decisions and holds across families.

watched_patterns.statement: Char density / structural integrity — not char height and not expansion ratio — controls fire-protection time (TTF): tall low-density foam detaches and exposes the substrate; short dense char holds.
watched_patterns.based_on: E-011 calibration on existing burn-test data · n=16 observational · char_height~TTF r=-0.63 · Fresco char noted soft/low-density vs competitor hard/dense
watched_patterns.source: E-011 (docs/E-011-calibration-result.md) — qualitative PASS vs known lab ground truth, NOT metrically validated
watched_patterns.note: Recovered a KNOWN lab understanding from data already in hand (more foam ≠ more protection; density decides). Watch only — the controlled experiment must scan toward CHAR_DENSITY to earn a metric boundary. Do NOT assert as an engineering rule; no ENG- rule encodes this and inventing one would fabricate support.
